message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover for Tempo magazine, dated July 15-21, 2024. The masthead "TEMPO" is large and red, situated above the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline reads "FULUS HAJI PLUS-PLUS" in bold black and outlined letters. 

The central illustration depicts a group of people boarding a large white airplane parked on a tarmac. A staircase is connected to the open cabin door, and a jet bridge extends from the right. The passengers, seen from behind, carry red and white suitcases on wheels. Many wear traditional attire: men in dark jackets, white pants, and black peci hats; women in long robes and head coverings. To the right, a man in a green shirt and glasses faces the queue, holding small red objects in both hands.

In the background, a large white terminal building with numerous dark rectangular windows stands under a stylized green dome-like structure. The sky is pale blue with wavy green and white bands. Text sections include "Jalur Baru Narkotik Asal Meksiko H.72," "Musim Rontok Industri Tekstil H.84," and a multi-line paragraph near the main headline referencing the Ministry of Religion and Hajj quotas. A barcode and QR code are in the top right.
